baseline_facts.content: Patient date of birth is thirty first October nineteen ninety.
Patient reports decreased hearing in the left ear.
Decreased hearing has been present for about six weeks.
Ear symptoms have been on and off over six weeks.
Patient reports occasional ringing in the left ear.
Doctor described the ringing as tinnitus.
Patient describes dizziness as feeling a little bit off balance.
Patient reports feeling a bit sick a few times.
Patient reports no hearing problems in the right ear.
Face-to-face ear examination is planned within the next four to five days.
Doctor will provide a leaflet link about tinnitus.
Condition is not considered an emergency.

Left-sided hearing symptoms are intermittent.

Patient reports mild nausea associated with dizziness.
Patient denies true room-spinning vertigo.
Patient denies ear pain.
Patient denies ear discharge.
No fever reported.

Patient denies palpitations with dizziness.
Listening to audio improves the left-sided ringing per patient.
